## Contributor checklist

<!-- These mirror Contributing.md. Tick each item you have confirmed. -->

- [ ] I searched the repository and this is **not a duplicate** (checked the URL and the name).
- [ ] The link uses **HTTPS** and points to the **canonical source** (official docs, the GitHub repo, or the primary paper — not a marketing or registry page).
- [ ] For a project: it is **more than 30 days old** and has **at least 60 stars**.
- [ ] The description is **neutral and factual**, starts with a capital, ends with a full stop, is **not** title-case, and does **not** begin with "A" or "An".
- [ ] The entry is in the **single best-fit category**, added at the **bottom** of that section (unless it is alphabetised or otherwise ordered).
- [ ] The link style **matches the surrounding section** (hyphen or em dash).
- [ ] This PR is **one logical change** (new categories or restructuring go in a separate PR).
- [ ] Spelling and grammar checked; no trailing whitespace.
